itemhighlighter.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
itemhighlighter.msg.hold_to_highlight: Hold an item to highlight it.
itemhighlighter.msg.not_a_color: Not a color. Start with #RRGGBB or a legacy code like &a (§a works too).
itemhighlighter.msg.unknown_item: Could not identify the held item.
itemhighlighter.msg.hold_to_clear: Hold an item to clear its highlight.
itemhighlighter.msg.none: No highlighted items. Press the highlight key or run /hl to open the menu.
itemhighlighter.screen.empty: Nothing highlighted. Search for an item, or press %s over one in any inventory.
itemhighlighter.screen.pick_color: Pick a color to highlight it
itemhighlighter.screen.nothing_selected: Pick an item on the left to color it. In any inventory, hover an item and press %s.
itemhighlighter.config.defaultColor.desc: Default highlight color (hex RGB) for items you highlight before picking one.
itemhighlighter.config.showTooltipLine.d: Append a colored "★ Highlighted" line to highlighted items' tooltips.
itemhighlighter.config.hotbarHighlight.d: Show a colored glow behind highlighted items in the hotbar, offhand, inventories and containers.
itemhighlighter.config.worldGlow.desc: Give highlighted dropped items and item frames a glowing outline in the world.
itemhighlighter.config.matchComponents.d: When on, only stacks identical to the highlighted one match (same enchantments, name, damage). When off, every item of the same type highlights.
